strategy_spec.economic_hypothesis: Price first deviates from session VWAP, then later reclaims VWAP while the intraday EMA trend is aligned.

execution.charges: Existing NSE intraday charge model used by backtest/backtest_engine.py; unchanged
execution.risk: Existing 1% research risk model and sizing; unchanged

held_out.provenance: Supplied Phase 18A constants only; neither file opened, parsed or hashed by preregistration

indicators.atr_role: Existing execution readiness and stop/target sizing; not an additional deviation/reclaim predicate
indicators.warm_up: Unchanged: EMA min_periods=period, RSI rolling(14), ATR rolling(14), VWAP cumulative close*volume / cumulative volume by session date

phase19_prohibitions: production or engine or session-policy changes

candidate_requires_all: at least one chronological half net-positive and the other not severely negative
no single trade >20% gross profit contribution
no single session >25% net profit contribution
not wholly dependent on BUY-only or SELL-only behavior
phase20_evaluation_gates.gross_failure_rule: Canonical gross net P&L <= 0 => REJECT unless a correctness defect makes the result uninterpretable; explicit fees are not the primary explanation of gross failure
phase20_evaluation_gates.precedence: Correctness defect makes results uninterpretable: RESEARCH FURTHER with no candidate claim; otherwise gross failure REJECT; otherwise trades <75 INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE; otherwise all gates pass CANDIDATE FOR SECOND HELD-OUT VALIDATION; otherwise RESEARCH FURTHER
phase20_evaluation_gates.qualitative_gates: Preserved verbatim; no invented numeric definition of severely negative or side dependence. An unestablished gate cannot be counted as passed.
phase20_evaluation_gates.sample_rule: If trades < 75, maximum classification INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE even if profitable; no loosened rerun
phase20_evaluation_gates.side_asymmetry: Symmetric frozen strategy; side statistics diagnostic only. No BUY-only, SELL-only or side-specific thresholds
phase20_evaluation_gates.single_run: Exactly one canonical first-exposure evaluation on this reserved dataset; no variants, threshold alternatives or post-result change and rerun. Identical deterministic reproduction only for correctness, not another candidate. Altered strategy is a new hypothesis requiring different unexposed data

strategy_spec.research_status: PREREGISTERED; DEFINITION + FREEZE ONLY; NOT EVALUATED
selection_contamination_disclosure: Prior March–September 2026 research informed the broad research direction
Strategy I rules were frozen before opening Phase 18 price data
Phase 18 Sep2025–Mar2026 price observations did not influence Strategy I parameter/rule choice
Phase 20 is intended as first exposure to this reserved dataset; this is not universal out-of-sample proof

state_machine.deviation_transition: WAIT_RECLAIM; no signal; EMA trend not required
state_machine.fail_closed: Missing, nonnumeric or nonfinite current or prior values needed by a rule => HOLD / no signal; preserve pending state. Missing prior EMA20 cannot reclaim.
state_machine.input_contract: Monotonically growing prefix of completed regular bars only; caller applies unchanged session policy; never supply future bars
state_machine.reclaim_transition: First strictly later completed regular bar satisfying ALL reclaim conditions emits direction and sets DONE
state_machine.session_reset: Both directions reset to WAIT_DEVIATION each session; no overnight state

strategy_spec.structural_distinction: Independent symmetric session state machines requiring deviation then a later VWAP reclaim with EMA alignment; not rejected A/D/E/F/G/H
